name: avsbhq/avsb
description: A vs B feature-flag and experimentation SDK for PHP.

suggest.laravel/framework: For the Laravel ServiceProvider and Facade
suggest.symfony/framework-bundle: For the Symfony Bundle and EventListener
suggest.psr/http-client: For Psr18Transport, which sends A vs B requests through the PSR-18 client you already have (Guzzle, Symfony HttpClient) so your middleware and proxy settings apply
suggest.psr/http-factory: For Psr18Transport, which needs a PSR-17 request factory (plus a stream factory for POST bodies)
